# Skills

| Name | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| adt-bootstrap | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-bootstrap/SKILL.md` | Bootstrap modular docs in a project from the Agentic Doc Templates pack. Use when the user says bootstrap, init modular docs, or Bootstrap the doc templates. Parent session only. |
| adt-template-sync | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-template-sync/SKILL.md` | Refresh the ADT pack and catch live docs up. Use when the user says update or sync the doc templates, update the doc templates, update ADT, or sync ADT. |
| adt-template-update-check | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-template-update-check/SKILL.md` | Check whether a newer ADT pack is available. Use when the user says check for template updates or check for ADT updates. |
| adt-rule-install | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-rule-install/SKILL.md` | Install or refresh ADT agent rules and skills for the tools this project uses. Use when the user says install agent rules, or install Cursor, Claude, or Grok rules. |
| adt-generate-role-adapters | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-generate-role-adapters/SKILL.md` | Regenerate Cursor, Grok, and Copilot role adapters from adapter-src. Use when the user says regenerate role adapters, or sync cursor or grok agents from adapter-src. |
| adt-understanding | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-understanding/SKILL.md` | Draft or revise a feature Understanding, capture intent, and apply the lock gate. Use when the user says draft or revise Understanding, new idea, capture intent, correct What this is / is not, or build live docs from docs/reference/. |
| adt-doc-graduate | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-doc-graduate/SKILL.md` | Graduate a confirmed Understanding into the durable spec. Use when the user says graduate a confirmed Understanding to a spec. |
| adt-product-vision | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-product-vision/SKILL.md` | Draft or lock the whole-product end-state picture. Use when the user says lock product shape, draft Product-Vision, or the product vision is missing or fights a feature. |
| adt-docs-profile | `docs/templates/agent/skills/adt-docs-profile/SKILL.md` | Suggest, record, or change the docs profile, and apply standing playbook overrides that need a full procedure. Use when docs_profile is unset, the user says set docs profile, or standing instructions need a cleanout or an upgrade. |
